status: Experimental Rust flat-list Enter action qualified; browser and durable list integration remain incomplete

contracts.input: No input; explicit host registration only
contracts.operation: One FlatListTextReplace with exact root guards and authoritative full-result preview
contracts.split: Nonempty items stay in their list; left block retains kind, right retains endpoint kind unless suffix empty, which becomes a paragraph
contracts.emptyItemExit: Collapsed empty item becomes a bare paragraph; retained prefix/suffix lists keep marker families and original ordinal starts
contracts.bareBlocks: Existing heading policy: start/middle preserve rank, end creates a paragraph, empty heading converts to one paragraph; bare paragraphs split
contracts.crossContainer: Retain left/right endpoint families separately; remove selected middle roots; right ordered section starts at original endpoint item ordinal; no automatic list merge or restart
contracts.sameContainer: Original list start retained; later ordinals follow resulting item count
contracts.selection: After-affinity child boundary at right block start or exited paragraph; pending formats retained; exact directional undo for recorded edits
contracts.history: One record-history event for document changes; structurally unchanged existing-break replacement is selection-only with no new undo entry
contracts.limits: Final-result node/item/root budgets; numbering overflow explicitly disabled; no transient delete/split intermediate required
contracts.state: Document, selection, pending formats, context and snapshot dependencies; stale prepared actions reject; disabled execution preserves existing redo
contracts.wire: No default/browser registry change and no operation/session wire widening

verification.propertyOracle: Independent Unicode scalar slicing and expected string/list construction, randomized rank/ordered start, exact selection/pending-format undo and redo
